remarks: Completely renovated and move-in ready, this bright 3rd-floor apartment offers comfort, efficiency, and an unbeatable Springdale location. The unit features a brand-new kitchen with new appliances, updated flooring throughout, and new carpeting in the living room, bedroom, and closets. Sound board has been installed under all floors and the second-floor ceiling is insulated, creating a quieter, more peaceful living environment. Designed for efficiency, the apartment is very economical to heat as warm air naturally rises through the construction. Generous closet and storage space add to the convenience. Enjoy free laundry, and one assigned driveway parking space, with ample off-street parking always available. Just minutes from the Springdale train station and within walking distance to local restaurants, shopping, and everyday conveniences, this location truly has it all. (appliances are in the process of being installed)
